"Last Updated: September 3, 2025

" "Thank you for using NoughtPad ("the App"). This policy explains what information we collect and how it is used and protected.

" "1. Information We Collect
" "To provide a multi-device experience, we collect the following information:
" " • Account Information: When you create an account, we collect information such as your email address and a unique user ID.
" " • User Content: We collect the text, images, and associated data (like reminders and expense details) that you create or share with the App.

" "2. How We Use Your Information
" "Your information is used to provide and improve the App's functionality:
" " • To Sync Your Content: Your notes, reminders, and expenses are stored securely on our servers to allow you to access them from any of your devices.
" " • To Provide AI Features: To power our "Smart Analyze" features, your content is sent securely to Google's Generative AI APIs (Gemini) for analysis. Google does not use this data to train their models.
" " • For Communication: We may use your email address to send you important information about your account or the App.

" "3. Data Storage and Security
" " • Server Storage: Your User Content is stored and encrypted on our secure cloud servers.
" " • Local Storage: A copy of your data is also stored in a private database on your local device to enable offline access.

" "4. Data Sharing
" "We do not sell your data. Your data is only shared with Google for AI processing as described above.

" "5. Your Control and Rights
" "You have complete control over your data.
" " • Deletion: Deleting an item within the App will also delete it from our servers. You can also request the deletion of your entire account.

"
